/ministries.name: Ibyiringiro Choir
/ministries.shortDescription: Ibyiringiro Choir serves God through song at the Free Methodist Church in Rwanda, Kicukiro Parish.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Korali Ibyiringiro ni korali ikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero Methodiste Libre mu Rwanda, Paruwasi ya Kicukiro.
/ministries.body: Ibyiringiro Choir serves God through song at the Free Methodist Church in Rwanda, Kicukiro Parish. Through its songs it leads the church in worship and shares the hope we have in Christ.
/ministries.bodyRw: Korali Ibyiringiro ni korali ikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero Methodiste Libre mu Rwanda, Paruwasi ya Kicukiro. Binyuze mu ndirimbo, iyobora itorero mu kuramya kandi ikamamaza ibyiringiro dufite muri Kristo.

/ministries.name: Narada Choir
/ministries.shortDescription: Narada Choir serves God through song at the Free Methodist Church in Rwanda, Kicukiro Parish.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Korali Narada ni korali ikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero Methodiste Libre mu Rwanda, Paruwasi ya Kicukiro.
/ministries.body: Narada Choir serves God through song at the Free Methodist Church in Rwanda, Kicukiro Parish. Its praise and worship songs help believers draw near to God.
/ministries.bodyRw: Korali Narada ni korali ikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero Methodiste Libre mu Rwanda, Paruwasi ya Kicukiro. Indirimbo zayo zo kuramya no guhimbaza zifasha abakristo kwegera Imana.

/ministries.name: Reverence Worship Team
/ministries.shortDescription: Reverence Worship Team leads the church in praise and worship during services.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Itsinda ry’Abaramyi Reverence riyobora itorero mu kuramya no guhimbaza Imana mu guterana kwera.
/ministries.body: Reverence Worship Team serves at the Free Methodist Church in Rwanda, Kicukiro Parish, leading the congregation in praise and worship.
/ministries.bodyRw: Itsinda ry’Abaramyi Reverence rikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero Methodiste Libre mu Rwanda, Paruwasi ya Kicukiro, riyobora itorero mu kuramya no guhimbaza Imana.

/ministries.name: Fruta Melody Choir
/ministries.shortDescription: Fruta Melody Choir serves God through song at the Free Methodist Church in Rwanda, Kicukiro Parish.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Korali Fruta Melody ni korali ikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero Methodiste Libre mu Rwanda, Paruwasi ya Kicukiro.
/ministries.body: Fruta Melody Choir serves God through song at the Free Methodist Church in Rwanda, Kicukiro Parish. It is a youth choir that praises God and encourages young people to follow Jesus.
/ministries.bodyRw: Korali Fruta Melody ni korali ikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero Methodiste Libre mu Rwanda, Paruwasi ya Kicukiro. Ni korali y’urubyiruko ihimbaza Imana kandi igashishikariza urubyiruko gukurikira Yesu.

/ministries.name: Maranata Choir
/ministries.shortDescription: Maranata Choir serves God through song at the Free Methodist Church in Rwanda, Kicukiro Parish.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Korali Maranata ni korali ikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero Methodiste Libre mu Rwanda, Paruwasi ya Kicukiro.
/ministries.body: Maranata Choir serves God through song at the Free Methodist Church in Rwanda, Kicukiro Parish. It is a children’s choir that teaches children to praise God with joy.
/ministries.bodyRw: Korali Maranata ni korali ikorera umurimo w’Imana mu Itorero Methodiste Libre mu Rwanda, Paruwasi ya Kicukiro. Ni korali y’abana yigisha abana guhimbaza Imana bishimye.

/ministries.name: Men Fellowship
/ministries.shortDescription: Men of Kicukiro Parish meet to pray, study God’s Word and support one another.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Abagabo bo muri Paruwasi ya Kicukiro bahurira hamwe mu gusenga, kwiga Ijambo ry’Imana no gufashanya.
/ministries.body: Men of Kicukiro Parish meet to pray, study God’s Word and support one another as they serve God in their homes, the church and the community.
/ministries.bodyRw: Abagabo bo muri Paruwasi ya Kicukiro bahurira hamwe mu gusenga, kwiga Ijambo ry’Imana no gufashanya, kugira ngo bakorere Imana mu ngo zabo, mu itorero no mu muryango nyarwanda.

/ministries.name: Women Fellowship
/ministries.shortDescription: Women of Kicukiro Parish meet to pray, study God’s Word and serve the church.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Abagore bo muri Paruwasi ya Kicukiro bahurira hamwe mu gusenga, kwiga Ijambo ry’Imana no gukorera itorero.
/ministries.body: Women of Kicukiro Parish meet to pray, study God’s Word, support one another and serve the church with their gifts.
/ministries.bodyRw: Abagore bo muri Paruwasi ya Kicukiro bahurira hamwe mu gusenga, kwiga Ijambo ry’Imana, gufashanya no gukorera itorero bakoresheje impano zabo.

/ministries.name: Family Commission
/ministries.shortDescription: The Family Commission helps couples and families grow strong in faith.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Komisiyo y’Umuryango ifasha ingo n’imiryango gukomera mu kwizera.
/ministries.body: The Family Commission walks with couples and families through teaching, counselling and family events.
/ministries.bodyRw: Komisiyo y’Umuryango iba hafi y’ingo n’imiryango binyuze mu nyigisho, inama n’ibikorwa by’umuryango.

/ministries.name: Cell Groups
/ministries.shortDescription: Cell groups bring believers together to pray, study the Bible and share the Gospel.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Amatsinda ahuza abakristo kugira ngo basengere hamwe, bige Bibiliya kandi bamamaze Ubutumwa Bwiza.
/ministries.body: Cell groups bring believers who live near each other together to pray, study the Bible, care for one another and share the Gospel.
/ministries.bodyRw: Amatsinda ahuza abakristo baturanye kugira ngo basengere hamwe, bige Bibiliya, bitaneho kandi bamamaze Ubutumwa Bwiza.

/ministries.name: ICT Team
/ministries.shortDescription: The ICT team runs sound, video and live streaming for church services.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Itsinda rya ICT ritunganya amajwi, amashusho n’ibiganiro bitambuka kuri interineti.
/ministries.body: The ICT team makes sure sound, video and live streaming work well during every service.
/ministries.bodyRw: Itsinda rya ICT rituma amajwi, amashusho n’ibiganiro bitambuka kuri interineti bigenda neza mu materaniro yose.

/ministries.name: Protocol Team
/ministries.shortDescription: The protocol team welcomes guests and keeps services running in order.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Itsinda rya Protocole ryakira abashyitsi kandi rigafasha amateraniro kugenda neza.
/ministries.body: The protocol team welcomes visitors, guides members to their seats and helps every service run in good order.
/ministries.bodyRw: Itsinda rya Protocole ryakira abashyitsi, ryereka abakristo aho bicara kandi rigafasha amateraniro kugenda neza.

/ministries.name: Prayer Team
/ministries.shortDescription: The prayer team prays for the church, families and the nation.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Itsinda ry’Amasengesho risengera itorero, imiryango n’igihugu.
/ministries.body: The prayer team gathers believers to pray for the church, for families, for those in need and for the nation.
/ministries.bodyRw: Itsinda ry’Amasengesho rihuza abakristo gusengera itorero, imiryango, abafite ibibazo n’igihugu.

/ministries.name: Church Advisors
/ministries.shortDescription: Church advisors support the parish leadership with wise counsel.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Abajyanama b’Itorero bagira inama ubuyobozi bwa Paruwasi.
/ministries.body: Church advisors support the parish leadership with counsel so that God’s work is done well.
/ministries.bodyRw: Abajyanama b’Itorero bagira inama ubuyobozi bwa Paruwasi kugira ngo umurimo w’Imana ukorwe neza.

/ministries.name: Youth
/ministries.shortDescription: Young people of Kicukiro Parish grow together in faith and serve God.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Urubyiruko rwa Paruwasi ya Kicukiro ruhurira hamwe kugira ngo rukure mu kwizera kandi rukorere Imana.
/ministries.body: Young people of Kicukiro Parish meet for teaching, worship and service, growing together as followers of Jesus.
/ministries.bodyRw: Urubyiruko rwa Paruwasi ya Kicukiro ruhurira hamwe mu nyigisho, kuramya no gukora umurimo w’Imana, rukura mu kwizera.

/ministries.name: Sunday School
/ministries.shortDescription: Sunday School teaches children God’s Word in a way they understand.
/ministries.shortDescriptionRw: Ishuri ryo ku Cyumweru ryigisha abana Ijambo ry’Imana mu buryo bubakwiriye.
/ministries.body: Every Sunday, children learn God’s Word through lessons, songs and activities suited to their age.
/ministries.bodyRw: Buri cyumweru, abana biga Ijambo ry’Imana binyuze mu masomo, indirimbo n’ibikorwa bijyanye n’imyaka yabo.

/announcements.title: Joy at the Praise and Worship Concert
/announcements.content: Kicukiro Parish held a praise and worship concert full of joy, music and thanksgiving to God.
/announcements.titleRw: Ibyishimo mu Giterane cyo Kuramya no Guhimbaza
/announcements.contentRw: Paruwasi ya Kicukiro yagize igiterane cyo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana cyuzuyemo ibyishimo n’indirimbo.

/announcements.title: Families Married Before God and the Law
/announcements.content: At Kicukiro Parish, couples who were living together without marriage were officially married in a blessed ceremony.
/announcements.contentRw: Muri Paruwasi ya Kicukiro, abashakanye bari batarasezerana basezeranye imbere y’Imana n’imbere y’amategeko.

/announcements.title: Family Week at Kicukiro Parish
/announcements.content: Kicukiro Parish celebrated a week dedicated to strengthening families in faith and love.
/announcements.titleRw: Icyumweru cy’Umuryango muri Paruwasi ya Kicukiro
/announcements.contentRw: Paruwasi ya Kicukiro yizihije icyumweru cyahariwe gukomeza ingo mu kwizera no mu rukundo.

/events.title: Kigali Conference Meeting
/events.description: Three days of teaching and fellowship for church leaders and members.
/events.descriptionRw: Iminsi itatu y’inyigisho no gusabana ku bayobozi n’abakristo.

/events.title: Family Week
/events.description: A week dedicated to strengthening families in faith and love.
/events.descriptionRw: Icyumweru cyahariwe gukomeza ingo mu kwizera no mu rukundo.

/events.title: Praise and Worship Concert
/events.description: A day of praise and worship with our choirs.
/events.descriptionRw: Umunsi wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana hamwe na korali zacu.

/notices.title: Welcome to our new website
/notices.titleRw: Murakaza neza ku rubuga rwacu rushya
/notices.body: Church notices will be published here every week. Check this page for the latest communication from the parish.
/notices.bodyRw: Amatangazo y’itorero azajya atangazwa hano buri cyumweru. Jya usura uru rupapuro umenye amakuru mashya ya Paruwasi.
